messages:
Niki: Quick shout  anyone up for a 'sunset micro-tri' challenge today at 17:30? 10-min swim (pool lanes), 10-min bike on the trainer, 10-min easy run. Low pressure, just a silly sprint to end the day. :swimmer: :bike: :running:
Owen: That sounds delightfully chaotic. Pool lanes free at 17:30? Last time I checked lane 3 was for lap swimmers only.
Farah: Im tempted but can only do run+bike. Meeting at 18:15. Can I join half?
Diego: Ill do all three if we keep it friendly. Also bringing a tiny bell to ding at transitions. :bell: 
Niki: Half-join totally fine. The idea is fun not hardcore. Pool has a public lane schedule but they usually open a lane for 30 mins after 5. I can reserve if enough people.
Wellness-bot: Event created: "Sunset micro-tri (10/10/10)" @17:30 (40m). Reminder 15m before.
Owen: Logistics Qs: shower time after? I have dinner plans at 19:00 and need to not reek. :sweat_smile:
Farah: Towels and hairdryer in locker 2, stalls usually free after 18:00 but might be tight. Bring deodorant.
Diego: Rule: no podium pics unless everyone consents. This is friendly. Also last person to transition owes a round of post-work smoothies. :tropical_drink: 
Niki: Smoothie wager accepted. Ill reserve lane 2 for us for 30 mins. If pool schedule blocks it, backup plan is an extra set at the stairs.
Owen: Transition tip: leave shoes at the bike rack, towel on saddle to claim your trainer. Also quick-change outfit in a small tote helps.
Farah: Ill bike+run then. If I get the smoothie dare, Ill sing a chorus of something embarrassing.
Diego: Team music vote: pump-up playlist or mellow sunset? I vote mellow so we dont scare lap swimmers.
Niki: Mellow it is. Also reminder: if anyone has recent swim lane experience and wants to do drills, keep it slow to avoid waves.
Wellness-bot: Weather/traffic note: mild breeze, pool parking typically 10 spots available after 17:00.
Owen: Count: full tri 2 (Niki, Diego), half tri 1 (Farah), maybe 1 (Owen) depending on lane availability.
Niki: Meetup: pool lobby at 17:20 for towel/bike setup, transitions quick brief at 17:25. Post a 1-line recap here after and optional pics in #random.
Diego: On my way. Bring a spare pair of socks for the run. See you soon!
Farah: See you there  Ill bring bandaids and hair ties.
Owen: Ill bring a tiny speaker and my terrible singing voice (for the smoothie dare). Good luck, losers.
